description: energy-py-linear is the ADG Efficiency-maintained Python library for scheduling batteries, combined heat and power, electric-vehicle charging, heat pumps and renewable generators. It formulates mixed-integer linear optimisation for individual assets or a site containing several assets. Inputs are asset limits, electricity prices and heat or charging requirements; outputs are optimised operating schedules. Spatial coverage follows the configured site, while the supplied time-series length sets the simulation horizon. Electricity and high- and low-temperature heat balances are represented. Source is free under GPL-3.0 with Python 3.11/3.12 installation and executable examples. A limitation is that linear asset representations and chosen constraints require checking against the physical installation; users must supply the relevant prices and loads. The library can compare cost or emissions objectives in local-energy infrastructure simulations. TESPy (model-tespy) offers related component-level thermal calculations. No optimiser or dataset was installed.
